def wrap(t,cn,maxw):
    if cn:
        n=len(t)
        if n<=maxw:return [t]
        k=(n+1)//2;return [t[:k],t[k:]]
    w=t.split(' ');
    if len(t)<=maxw:return [t]
    best=None
    for i in range(1,len(w)):
        l=' '.join(w[:i]);r=' '.join(w[i:])
        if len(l)<=maxw and len(r)<=maxw:
            if best is None or abs(len(l)-len(r))<abs(len(best[0])-len(best[1])):best=(l,r)
